note: The twenty-third registration's exam seeds (pt-v22's registration 23, after grade 22; owner decisions 8 and 10-16, registration 19's items 3 and 5). Every exam seed is its held-out counterpart plus 9420000, except the long run's pool (9421201-9421830,9423201-9423830) and the arrival-order pool (9424001-9424400), which take blocks of their own. No seed of this file had been run by any recorded run when it was registered (the registration's proof).
